candidate_text.partition: 7 vtable-targeted class functions (0x0994 bytes) plus 2 non-member helper functions (0x0204 bytes)

rtti.evidence: Linked ov003 words at 0x020b1758 are {0x0209a764, 0x020b1784, 0x020914d4}; the bytes at 0x020b1784 are the NUL-terminated RTTI name "13dScGameOver_c" (0x10 bytes through 0x020b1794). The single-base __si kind vptr 0x0209a764 is the same one dScMgD3DBase_c's record carries (notes/data/class-facts/dScMgD3DBase_c.json).

related_modules.role: inherited slots (fBase_c/dBase_c/dScene_c bodies), ancestor RTTI, and every arm9 helper this TU calls
class RTTI, vtable, own overrides, candidate text, and the four data tables it reads

base_evidence: _ZTI13dScGameOver_c at 0x020b1758 has +0x08 = 0x020914d4, which config/arm9/symbols.txt names _ZTI8dScene_c. Corroborated by vtable length: _ZTV13dScGameOver_c is 18 slots, exactly dScene_c's own 18, and no new virtual is added.

vtable.extent_evidence: The 18 consecutive words from the address point 0x020b179c through 0x020b17e0 are all code pointers into ov003 or arm9. The next word at 0x020b17e4 is 0x81f000f0, which is not a code address in any loaded module, and ov003's symbols.txt independently starts a new data symbol data_ov003_020b17e4 there. There are no trailing null slots to qualify. 0x020b17e4 - 0x020b1794 = 0x50, the whole emitted section including the two header words. Note the ROM's _ZTV symbol IS the address point, so the section starts 8 bytes below the manifest address.

overrides.name: InitResources
overrides.body: Brings both engines up: DisableAllBanks, four SetBankFor* calls, graphics modes, then BG control-register setup for main BG0/BG1/BG2 and sub BG0/BG1/BG2. Loads the language-specific "GAME OVER" art on both screens (five variants keyed off GetOwnerLanguage()), the debug font, the OAM glyph tiles and palettes. Calls func_ov003_020b0730(this, 1) to prime the yes/no highlight, zeroes the five state bytes at 0x090..0x094, lays the eight glyphs out from data_ov003_020b1764 into unk_050 with y=0x60, scale=0x30, rotation=0, then starts the game-over music. Returns 1.

overrides.name: CleanupResources
overrides.body: `return 1;` -- eight bytes. The scene owns no allocation of its own.

overrides.name: Behavior
overrides.body: Gated on a virtual call through the global object at data_0209f5bc (vtable slot 0x14). Runs the glyph drop animation via func_ov003_020b060c(this), then, once unk_094 >= 2, a two-state cursor FSM: state 0 reads the stylus box and the button and picks yes/no; state 1 runs the two countdowns down and commits -- func_0202ae74() on "yes", dScene_c::StartSceneFade(1, 0, 0) on "no" -- then stops the music. Returns 1.

overrides.name: Render
overrides.body: Draws the eight "GAME OVER" glyph sprites through OAM::Render from data_ov003_020b1824[i] at unk_050[i]/unk_060[i] with scale 0x1000 and no rotation, then calls Stage::RenderBouncingArrows() once unk_094 >= 2. Returns 1.

overrides.name: OnPendingDestroy
overrides.body: `bx lr` -- four bytes, an empty body.

overrides.name: D1 destructor
overrides.body: Stores vptr &_ZTV13dScGameOver_c[2], then dScene_c's and dBase_c's vptrs inline, then calls fBase_c::~fBase_c at 0x02043d48. No member destruction: every own field is a scalar.

overrides.name: D0 deleting destructor
overrides.body: The same chain as D1, then Memory::Deallocate(this, GAME_HEAP_PTR) through the operator delete dScGameOver_c inherits from its immediate base dScene_c.

tu_nearby_free_helpers.reason: Called only from Behavior at 0x020b08b8 with r0 = this. It reads and writes this object's fields at +0x50, +0x70 and +0x94, so it takes the receiver, but it carries no mangled name and the ROM gives it none; it is the glyph drop-in animation step. Its one caller is inside the class region.

Called from InitResources at 0x020b1080 and from Behavior at three sites, always with r0 = this and a second argument in r1. Reads this+0x91 and this+0x93 and repaints the sub-screen BG1 highlight over the yes/no boxes. Same shape as the previous helper: takes the receiver, has no mangled name, and every caller is inside the class region.

size_evidence.lower_bound: InitResources zeroes five bytes at this+0x090..0x094 and Behavior/Render read them back, proving occupancy through 0x95.
size_evidence.upper_bound: dScGameOver_c_classInit at 0x020b1118 opens with _ZN7fBase_cnwEj(0x98) -- fBase_c::operator new with the literal 0x98. 0x98 - 0x95 = 3 bytes of trailing padding to the class's own 4-byte alignment.
size_evidence.member_extent: Everything below 0x50 is inherited from fBase_c/dBase_c/dScene_c, which add no members of their own (include/dScene_c.h). InitResources fills four back-to-back 8-entry s16 arrays at 0x050/0x060/0x070/0x080 and Render reads the first two back; the five state bytes follow at 0x090.

fields.name: unk_050
fields.evidence: InitResources writes eight s16 entries from data_ov003_020b1764; func_ov003_020b060c walks the same eight with a 2-byte stride; Render passes unk_050[i] as the OAM x coordinate.

fields.name: unk_060
fields.evidence: InitResources writes 0x60 into eight s16 entries; Render passes unk_060[i] as the OAM y coordinate.

fields.name: unk_070
fields.evidence: InitResources writes 0x30 into eight s16 entries; func_ov003_020b060c uses the same eight as per-glyph delay counters.

fields.name: unk_080
fields.evidence: InitResources zeroes eight s16 entries. No other reader in this TU.

fields.name: unk_090
fields.evidence: Behavior switches on it as a two-state cursor FSM and writes 1 on commit; InitResources zeroes it.

fields.name: unk_091
fields.evidence: Behavior uses it as the left/right selection and func_ov003_020b0730 compares it against the box index.

fields.name: unk_092
fields.evidence: Behavior loads 0x10*data_0208ee44 into it and counts it down to commit.

fields.name: unk_093
fields.evidence: Behavior loads 0x08*data_0208ee44 into it and counts it down; func_ov003_020b0730 reads it to decide the highlight colour.

fields.name: unk_094
fields.evidence: func_ov003_020b060c drives it 0 -> 1 -> 2 as the glyph animation finishes; Behavior and Render both gate on >= 2.

fields.name: pad_095
fields.evidence: Nothing reads or writes it; it is the span between the last proven byte and the 0x98 allocator literal.

unproven: Semantic names for any own field: the offsets, widths and roles above are proven by ROM accesses, but no ROM string or symbol names them.

Original source linkage of the two helper bodies at 0x020b060c and 0x020b0730: both take this object's address as their first argument and are called only from within the class region, which is consistent with static file-scope helpers, but adjacency and call shape do not prove static versus external linkage or the original translation-unit cut. The ROM gives them no mangled name, so they were not class members with external linkage.
The identity of the global object at data_0209f5bc whose vtable slot 0x14 gates Behavior; only its call shape (a virtual call taking itself as receiver, returning a truth value) is proven.
The element type of data_ov003_020b1824: Render passes each entry straight to OAM::Render's OamAttr* parameter, which proves the pointer type at that call and nothing about the pointed-to layout.
Any vtable slot after slot 17: the linked bytes prove the table ends at 0x020b17e4, and no trailing null slot is present to preserve an otherwise unobservable declaration.

Whether dScGameOver_c declares an operator delete of its own: D0 deallocates through Memory::Deallocate(this, GAME_HEAP_PTR) inline, which is equally consistent with inheriting dScene_c's inline copy (the reading include/dScGameOver_c.h takes) and with a private copy of the same body.
